verifications.claim: Pokémon Champions launches on Nintendo Switch on April 8, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Pokémon Champions release date is set for Wednesday, April 8, 2026." (R1); "available starting April 8" (R2); "launches tomorrow, April 8" (R3); "Pokémon Champions technically has an April 8 release date" (R4); "Pokémon Champions releases on Wednesday 8th April, 2026 for Nintendo Switch" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm release on April 8, 2026, for Nintendo Switch (and/or Switch 2).

verifications.claim: Reports indicate that Pokémon Champions will go live around 12:00 JST on April 8.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "official post ... says the game will launch “around noon” in Japan" (R1); "Tokyo (JST) - 12:00, April 8" (R2, R4)
verifications.reasoning: R1 reports official 'around noon' JST; R2 and R4 specify 12:00 JST, directly supporting.

verifications.claim: Pokémon Champions launches at 8:00 PM PST on April 7 in Los Angeles.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "8PM PT ... April 7" (R1 speculation); "Los Angeles (PST) - 20:00, April 7" (R2, R4); "8 p.m. Pacific" (R3); vs. "North America (PT)9:00 PM April 7" (R1 table); "9PM PDT ... west coast" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: R2, R3, R4, and R1 speculation support 8 PM PST/PT April 7; R1 table and R5 contradict with 9 PM.

verifications.reasoning: R2, R3, R4, and R1 speculation support 11 PM EST/ET April 7; R1 table and R5 contradict with 12 AM April 8.
